title: Jones College Volleyball Beats Pearl River 3-1 to Avenge Early-Season Loss
content:
ELLISVILLE — No. 22 Jones College defeated No. 25 Pearl River 3-1 in volleyball Monday, Oct. 12, at A.B. Howard Gymnasium, reversing an earlier four-set loss in Poplarville.

Jones won the first two sets 25-10 and 25-20. Pearl River took the third 25-19 before the Bobcats closed the match with a 25-17 victory. Jones improved to 21-5 overall and 6-1 in conference play; Pearl River fell to 22-6 and 6-2.

Myah Favre led Jones with 24 kills and added 15 digs. Selah Sandridge had 13 kills and Izzi Barnes contributed 11. Claire Wicker recorded 40 assists, while Olivia Guth led the team with 20 digs.

Source: Jones College Athletics

Correction: The headline has been corrected to “avenge,” and Jones’ ranking has been updated to No. 22 to match the official recap and box score. The source link has also been repaired.
